description: Shared search cache correctness/performance evidence; benchmark preceded demo deployment. See companion Markdown for earlier failed attempts and subsequent deployment checks.
measurement_scope: API TestClient on macOS, PostgreSQL on disk-backed Linux Docker; excludes browser rendering/automation and network transit. Post-load VACUUM ANALYZE plus declared 60-second idle, no search/oracle warm-up; first request measured. Single-client maintained-data evidence, not concurrent or cold-disk SLA.
